titles.romaji: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Mezase! Kameari Superstar!! - Ryoutsu-shiki Idol e no Michi!
titles.native: こちら葛飾区亀有公園前派出所スペシャル 目指せ！亀有スーパースター！！～両津式アイドルへの道！～

description:
Special episodes of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast after the TV series.

Note: Originally broadcasted in two different parts. Streaming sites may have the special as a single 46-minute-long episode.
